id.description: Unique id to identify exchange rate, i.e. concatenated values of type, currencyIdFrom and currencyIdTo. For instance SALES-EUR-NOK.

Config.title: Config
Config.description: Set of available settings for exchange rate

currencyIdFrom.description: Currency the rate is expressed in — the currency being converted TO. ISO4217.

currencyIdTo.description: Currency being priced — the currency being converted FROM. ISO4217.

exchangeRate.description: Amount of currencyIdFrom equivalent to one unit of currencyIdTo. Multiply an amount in currencyIdTo to obtain currencyIdFrom. Example: currencyIdFrom=SEK, currencyIdTo=EUR, exchangeRate=11.20 means 1 EUR = 11.20 SEK.

createdBy.description: Who wrote the rate: global-exr-scheduler for the automatic ECB import, otherwise the user id of the Exchange Rates API caller. Not set by the config portal.
